leaderboard_improvement_over_time.tool: Validator-scored Launchpad confirmations from stage A

credibility_layers.rule: Code verification is a required exit criterion of the reference stage (Test Lead, from the owner, 2026-10-10): a Method of Manufactured Solutions test, or an exact analytic-solution test where MMS is not practical, showing the observed order of accuracy matches the scheme's theoretical order, re-run on any image rebuild or re-pin. Recorded beside solution verification and validation.

code_verification.flag: required for the reference stage exit
code_verification.tool: None yet: a Method of Manufactured Solutions test, or an exact analytic-solution test where MMS is not practical, per pinned image; re-run on any rebuild or re-pin

solution_verification.tool: Refinement and conservation checks on the pinned package (value-cost T5, reference adequacy)

validation.tool: Benchmark comparisons for the pinned package, recorded beside the other two layers

decision_quality_vs_cheap_baseline.tool: Data Collection panels, PR 994 (CHEAP-BASELINE-COMPARATORS-01, open) and the evaluator PR 1003 (PASSES-VALUE-EVALUATOR-01, open)

a_real_buyer_decision_two_sources.condition: A real buyer decision with at least two sources.
a_real_buyer_decision_two_sources.tool: The Challenge packet's engineering-job section and the buyer-volume evidence (PR 939, merged)

b_regret_below_cheap_baseline_paired_boo.condition: Buyer-unit regret lower than the strongest cheap baseline's at matched admissibility, paired bootstrap 95% interval excluding 0.
b_regret_below_cheap_baseline_paired_boo.tool: Data Collection panels, PR 994 comparators (open) and the evaluator PR 1003 (open)

c_speed_up_100x_per_decision_query.condition: At least 100x faster than the reference per decision query.
c_speed_up_100x_per_decision_query.tool: Data Collection reference timing plus the model inference cost, on the same hardware

d_value_and_volume_ranges.condition: Sourced or assumption ranges for value and volume.
d_value_and_volume_ranges.tool: The Challenge packet and the buyer-volume evidence (PR 939, merged)

e_equal_budget_screen_then_verify_beats_.condition: At equal time and compute, the model-screen-then-solver-verify workflow finds a better design than the solver alone.
e_equal_budget_screen_then_verify_beats_.tool: PR 998 (EQUAL-BUDGET-DESIGN-01, open) on the design_search track_b harness
